fitReason: Current work directly connects learned tactile/text representations with transformer manipulation policies, giving a concrete AI-methods fit beyond her mechanical robot-design program.

physicalEvidence.summary: September 27, 2026 primary manuscript documents actual Franka Emika Panda/parallel-jaw and DeltaHand experiments. Tactile exploration supplies learned, text-aligned object context to an Action Chunking Transformer for rearranging, pouring and opening boxes. Training uses 180, 80 and 50 demonstrations respectively. Object-property prediction and actual policy success are evaluated separately. Exploration follows predefined procedures and precedes manipulation; adaptive task-driven online exploration is future work.
